posts.title: Surfing Airwaves with Flipper Zero
posts.description: In my efforts to become a criminal overlord of midwest suburbia, I have acquired the ultimate hacking tool; a Flipper Zero! With this device, I can annoy my wife, defeat neighborhood children in games of laser-tag, and even inconvenience minimum wage employees at my local Walgreens! Suburbia may never know peace again.

posts.title: Pinpointing Pop!_OS Pains
posts.description: Spending time troubleshooting a workstation is frustrating, especially when it means work is no longer happening. When both of my workstations suffered from failing updates, I set out to find solutions. After my desktop failed to suspend or even power off, I fumbled around until I came up with a temporary fix.
